notes.text: The linked Yevamot has Rami bar Dikulei speaking in Shmuel’s name. The supplied Hebrew has Dikula. [Heilprin’s Dikula headword](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=935&lang=en) lists Rami as his son.
